title: AI and computer vision for wildlife identification in camera trap images: Fine-tuning SpeciesNet outperforms local models for species classification
publication_date_basis: PubMed PMID 42241933 Epub date, checked 24 October 2026; Crossref lists the August issue
reading_question: Compare a frozen local head and modest SpeciesNet fine-tuning on identical site and encounter holdouts before selecting a backbone.

evidence_note.finding: A comparison using 15 common Australian rainforest species favoured local fine-tuning of SpeciesNet, including evaluation on withheld cameras.
